name: Thickness planer
description: A floor planer that shaves boards flat to an even thickness. Needs power.
notes: A placed workshop machine; the size is only a placeholder. Modelled with its infeed and outfeed tables out. Its box is 1.8 times the reference volume because the tables and the throat under the head leave open space.

name: Router table
description: A heavy table with a router set under its top and a fence along the bit. Cuts grooves and edge profiles in wood. Needs power.
notes: I renamed the id: a bare router reads as the network device. The 500 kg reference mass is kept, which is heavy for a router table, so the top is cast iron on a steel cabinet. A placed workshop machine; the size is only a placeholder. Its box is 2.1 times the reference volume because the top overhangs the cabinet. routing is a new quality name.

name: Floodlight stand
description: A bright work light on a tall folding stand. Lights a wide area. Needs mains power.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x751): the reference volume of 2 L is a folded stand, while the model stands with its legs spread 0.94 m, so its box is mostly air. Height and mass match the reference. The directed variant aims the same head and shares this model. It gives light rather than a crafting quality, so it drafts none; how a placed mains light lights the world is left to the refactor.

name: Floor lamp
description: A tall lamp with a cloth shade on a weighted base. Needs mains power.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x165): the reference volume of 2 L counts the pole and base, not the space around them; the 0.44 m shade and 0.28 m base make the bounding box mostly air. Height and mass match the reference. It gives light rather than a crafting quality, so it drafts none.

name: Water purifier
description: A mains-powered unit with three filter bowls and an ultraviolet lamp. Makes dirty water safe to drink.
notes: Modelled as a wall or bench unit that stays where it is plugged in, so it drafts a workstation. water_purification is a new quality name; level 2 leaves room for a hand-held purifier at 1. The reference material is budget steel, drawn as a white-painted cabinet with stainless fittings.

name: Table saw
description: A cabinet saw with its blade rising through a cast-iron top and a rip fence along it. Makes straight cuts in board and sheet. Needs power.
notes: A placed workshop machine; the size is only a placeholder. Its box is 2.1 times the reference volume because the wings and fence rail overhang the cabinet.

name: Wall light
description: A round bulkhead light with a guard over its dome. Mounts on a wall and runs off mains power.
notes: CHECK VOLUME (x8.8): a bulkhead light 0.2 m across, the reference longest side, is about 9 cm deep, which no 0.4 L volume holds; I kept the 0.2 m size and mass. Modelled as it hangs on a wall, back plate at -z, standing on its rim. It gives light rather than a crafting quality, so it drafts none.
Skipped: wiring run through walls is part of a building, not a thing to pick up, and the reference weighs 1 g and fills 1 ml.
